contract.title: GLEE Acceptance Verifier
contract.purpose: Check a delivered unified diff against declared path rules and added-line assertions, then retain a signed acceptance receipt.
unsuitable_tasks: Resolve a remote commit without a diff
contract.payment_flow: POST the JSON body without payment to receive HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED; retry the identical body with an x402 V2 payment for the exact amount.
contract.deliverable: Settlement-bound acceptance verification: does this delivered patch satisfy the buyer's declared acceptance contract? Deterministic diff structure, path policy, Law 11 static safety, and literal assertions, returned as PASS/FAIL/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with a signed, offline-verifiable receipt

input.assertions: Optional [{type: contains|prohibits, pattern, message?}]; pattern is a JavaScript regular expression (1..256 chars) tested against added lines, and an invalid pattern fails the contract.
input.job_id: Optional opaque reference echoed in the receipt.

authentication.paid_execution: Operator-authorized x402 V2 payment signature; no agent-passport prerequisite.

free_evaluation.scope: Compute a verdict for one fixed synthetic example using the same static verifier as paid execution. Customer-supplied patches and assertions are not accepted here.
free_evaluation.attribution: Copy response.observation.discovery_source into the X-Discovery-Source header of an authorized paid invocation to link the request. This is caller-supplied attribution, not evidence of an independent agent.

example_invocation.payment: An unpaid POST returns a payment challenge when the service is ready.

verdict_rules.PASS: every declared acceptance condition evaluated and passed (score >= 80, no FATAL/CRITICAL finding)
verdict_rules.FAIL: a declared acceptance condition failed, or the declared contract is malformed
verdict_rules.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: a declared acceptance condition cannot be evaluated by v0; no pass/fail claim is made

verification.canonicalization: Recursively sort object keys; compact JSON; exclude the receipt.signature field.
verification.digest: SHA-256 hex of the canonical JSON (UTF-8).
verification.signature: Ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes of the digest hex string.

limitations: No patch application, code execution, or runtime guarantee
No proof of program correctness; static structural and policy checks only
Binary diffs, quoted paths, and rename-only changes are unsupported
Commit/URL/HTTP artifact bindings are not resolvable in v0 and yield INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
